title: 第011章 三修蛮横欺凡庶，小觑稚女起歹心
content_zh:
蔡文姬与王磊并肩踏入村口，一股压抑的戾气与浊气扑面而来。

    村口的老槐树枯枝败叶，树干布满诡异的黑色纹路，是被邪祟浊气长期浸染的痕迹。

    道路两侧的屋舍破旧坍塌，院墙破败，遍地狼藉，散落着破碎的陶罐与农具。

    偶尔有零星村民探出破旧的门窗，眼神惶恐、面色蜡黄、身形枯瘦。

    他们只敢偷偷打量外来的陌生人，一旦对上视线，便立刻慌张缩回头去，紧闭门窗，瑟瑟发抖。

    整个村子，人人自危，户户紧闭，活在无尽的恐惧与压迫之下。

    王磊眉头紧锁，指尖悄然按住腰间佩剑，压低声音提醒道：

    “蔡师妹小心，这里的邪气很重，比宗门传回的消息还要浓郁，那三个散修恐怕不止欺压凡人这么简单。”

    他常年在外历练，对邪祟浊气的感知极为敏锐，此刻全身灵力已然暗蓄，时刻保持着戒备状态。

    蔡文姬微微敛了眉眼，心底了然。

    看来周管事所言非虚，这一带村落，确实被恶修与邪祟祸害已久。

    她放缓脚步，柔声对着空荡的街巷开口，声音里悄然融入一丝【思无邪】的安抚音波：

    “诸位乡亲无需害怕，我们是清风宗下山历练的弟子，专程前来巡查，肃清此地恶患。”

    “今日之后，我保证无人再敢欺压你们，无人再敢祸乱村落。”

    清甜软糯的声音带着音律灵气的安抚效果，缓缓传遍整条街巷。

    无形的温柔音波力量散开，驱散了村民心头积压已久的恐惧与绝望。

    许久之后，一间最破败的土屋木门，被人小心翼翼地缓缓推开。

    一名白发苍苍、脊背佝偻的老奶奶，拄着腐朽的木拐，颤颤巍巍走了出来。

    老人眼眶通红，满脸褶皱，声音沙哑哽咽。

    王磊见状立刻上前一步，扶住老人摇摇欲坠的身子，温声说道：

    “老奶奶别怕，我们是清风宗的弟子，专门来除掉那些作恶的散修，保护大家的。”

    “仙、仙长……你们真的是来帮我们的？”

    蔡文姬快步上前，轻轻搀扶住老人的另一只手臂，温和点头。

    “奶奶，我们是来帮大家除恶安良的。”

    一句温柔的承诺，当场击溃了老人紧绷许久的防线。

    老奶奶浑浊的眼泪瞬间滚落，握着她的手不停颤抖。

    “盼了好久……我们终于盼来仙长了……”

    随着老人渐渐开口，落云村这些时日的遭遇，一点点铺展在两人眼前。

    半月之前，三名被各大宗门驱逐的散修，流窜到青螺山外的村落一带。
content_en:
Cai Wenji and Wang Lei stepped into the village entrance side by side, and a suppressed air of hostility and turbidity hit their faces.

    The old locust tree at the entrance of the village has dead branches and leaves, and the trunk is covered with strange black lines, which are the traces of long-term contamination by evil and turbid air.

    The houses on both sides of the road are dilapidated and collapsed, the courtyard walls are in ruins, and the ground is in a mess, with broken pottery pots and farm tools scattered around.

    Occasionally, a few villagers poked their heads out of the dilapidated doors and windows, their eyes frightened, their complexions sallow, and their bodies thin.

    They only dared to secretly look at the strangers outside. Once their eyes met, they immediately retreated in panic, closed the doors and windows tightly, and shivered.

    In the entire village, everyone is in danger, every household is closed, and they live under endless fear and oppression.

    Wang Lei frowned, his fingertips quietly pressed the sword on his waist, and lowered his voice to remind:

    "Junior sister Cai, be careful. The evil spirit here is very strong, even stronger than the news from the sect. Those three casual cultivators may not just bully ordinary people."

    He has been practicing outside for many years, and has an extremely keen sense of evil spirits. At this moment, his spiritual power has been secretly stored in his body, and he is always on alert.

    Cai Wenji frowned slightly, understanding in her heart.

    It seems that what Manager Zhou said is true. The villages in this area have indeed been plagued by evil cultivators and evil spirits for a long time.

    She slowed down and spoke softly to the empty streets, with a hint of [Siwuxie]'s soothing sound quietly incorporated into her voice:

    "Folks, there is no need to be afraid. We are disciples of the Qingfeng Sect who have come down from the mountain to gain experience. We have come specially to inspect and eliminate the evil in this place."

    "After today, I guarantee that no one will dare to bully you again, and no one will dare to cause trouble to the village again."

    The sweet and soft voice, with the soothing effect of musical aura, slowly spread throughout the streets.

    The invisible gentle sound wave power spread out, dispelling the long-standing fear and despair in the villagers' hearts.

    After a long time, the wooden door of a most dilapidated earthen house was carefully and slowly pushed open.

    An old woman with gray hair and a stooped back walked out tremblingly, leaning on a rotten wooden crutch.

    The old man's eyes were red, his face was wrinkled, and his voice was hoarse and choked with sobs.

    Upon seeing this, Wang Lei immediately stepped forward, supported the old man's shaky body, and said warmly:

    "Don't be afraid, old lady. We are disciples of the Qingfeng Sect. We are here to get rid of those rogue cultivators who do evil and protect everyone."

    "Immortal, Immortal...are you really here to help us?"

    Cai Wenji quickly stepped forward, gently supported the old man's other arm, and nodded gently.

    "Grandma, we are here to help everyone eliminate evil and make peace."

    A gentle promise broke the old man's tight defense on the spot.

    The old woman's muddy tears rolled down instantly, and the hand holding her kept shaking.

    "We have been looking forward to it for a long time... We finally look forward to the immortal..."

    As the old man gradually opened his mouth, the experiences of Luoyun Village these days were unfolded in front of their eyes.

    Half a month ago, three casual cultivators who were expelled from various sects fled to the villages outside Qingluo Mountain.
title_en: Chapter 011 The third cultivator bullies ordinary people and looks down on young girls with evil intentions
